g.text: From-scratch CNN capacity, continual learning and storage controls
Branch:525,014 parameters; PEC:522,927 including shared frozen teacher. PCA and external pretraining are absent.
Joint training uses all classes together; oracle inference uses true pair IDs. Neither is a deployable continual-learning result. Adam and peak RAM excluded.
